findings.title: Tool `send_email` is visually near-identical to `sеnd_email`
findings.policy_violated: MCP tool definitions must describe the tool, not instruct the model
findings.observed_action: tool names normalize to the same skeleton using different Unicode characters
findings.remediation: Rename the tool to remove the ambiguity. A visual look-alike can impersonate a tool the user or agent has already reviewed and trusted -- and, unlike a literal keyword match, evades naive checks that look only at the exact tool name.

findings.title: Tool `format_text` gives instructions about how to use `send_email`

findings.title: Tool `cleanup_temp_files` is annotated read-only but its name or description suggests a destructive action
